about: Figures the apps once kept for themselves and now ask the engine (#482): how often the live SWIM feeds are asked again (live_feed_refresh: RVR updated about once a minute, AIM 7-1-13; the rest the app's choice), the hours a search's "VFR at…" offers (vfr_at_hours, within a TAF's 24, FAA-H-8083-28B 27.4.1), and the first day an instructor's page lists, 3 years back (instructor_records_since, 14 CFR 61.189(c)). Held by the engine (engine/facade/tests/shell_figures.rs) and the web (lib/liveReports.test.ts, features/search/searchFilters.test.ts).
